items.text: **Welcome to the great Copilot Chat journey: Use case of the week!**

Welcome back to our 'Use case of the week' series, where we show how Copilot Chat can help with everyday tasks like drafting, organising information, analysing content, or planning next steps.

**No theory - just practical examples you can try immediately and see the difference in your daily work.**

Stay tuned as we build new Copilot habits, week by week!

body.text:
**SCENARIO DESCRIPTION**

This use case shows how Copilot Chat can help you turn messy notes (meeting notes, emails, Teams chat, bullet points) into a crisp **weekly status update** and a clear **action plan**.

You’ll paste your raw notes (or upload a document), ask Copilot Chat to identify progress, blockers, and decisions, then generate:
- A short executive summary
- A stakeholder-ready status email
- A table of actions (owner, due date, next step)

This scenario highlights how Copilot Chat boosts clarity, alignment, and follow-through.

**PROMPTS USED**

items.text: [✨ *Here are my raw notes from this week (paste below). Turn them into a weekly status update with: Progress, Blockers/Risks, Decisions, and Next Steps. Keep it concise and stakeholder-friendly.*]
[✨ *Create a short email version of this update for my manager. Use a professional tone and include 3 bullet highlights at the top.*]
[✨ *Extract action items and produce a table with: Task, Owner, Due date, Priority, and Dependencies. Flag any missing info as “data gap”.*]
[✨ *Now rewrite the update in two versions: (1) executive (max 120 words), (2) detailed (max 250 words).*]
